answer: Rhythm-Gated Dispatch. Each identity must space its first N actions by randomized delays drawn from a shared schedule; the scheduler hashes a per-round beacon into a marble-like slot map, so bursts collide and get dropped. Rate limits tighten against arrival comet patterns—clustered arrivals are throttled to a haven of near-zero throughput. Cost: an attacker must rent distinct identities kept idle across many rounds, paying latency and slot waste per fake agent.
